items.source: Default reset strategy iterating through each registered RedisCache and calling RedisCache.clear().
items.translation: 默认的重置策略会遍历每个已注册的RedisCache，并调用其RedisCache.clear()方法。

items.source: Reset strategy iterating through each registered RedisCache and calling RedisCache.invalidate().
items.translation: 重置策略通过遍历每个已注册的RedisCache并调用其invalidate()方法来实现。

items.source: Default reset strategy iterating through each registered RedisCache and calling RedisCache.clear(). Actual clearing may be performed in an asynchronous or deferred fashion, with subsequent lookups possibly still seeing the entries.
items.translation: 默认的重置策略会遍历每个已注册的RedisCache并调用其clear()方法。实际的清除操作可能是异步或延迟执行的，因此后续的查找仍可能看到这些条目。

items.source: Reset strategy iterating through each registered RedisCache and calling RedisCache.invalidate(). This strategy expects all entries to be immediately invisible for subsequent lookups.
items.translation: 重置策略会遍历每个已注册的RedisCache并调用其invalidate()方法。该策略期望所有条目在随后的查找中立即不可见。

items.source: Flush the Redis database using the FLUSHDB command.
items.translation: 使用FLUSHDB命令清空 Redis 数据库。

items.source: Flush the Redis database using the FLUSHDB command. This is the fastest way to reset all caches, but it will also wipe all keys in the database, which may not be desirable if the database holds keys that are not used by a cache or the database is shared with other applications keys. This strategy does not acquire or wait for any locks to be released.
items.translation: 使用 FLUSHDB 命令刷新 Redis 数据库。这是重置所有缓存的最快方法，但它也会清除数据库中的所有键，如果数据库中包含非缓存使用的键，或者该数据库与其他应用程序的键共享，则此操作可能并不理想。此策略不会获取或等待任何锁的释放。

items.source: Interface defining a strategy for resetting the cache.
items.translation: 定义缓存重置策略的接口。
克里斯托夫·施特罗布，马克·帕卢赫
